speech:
I accept your audit commitment and its limits. I will absorb preparation of the named handoff acknowledgement and two clinic records into the existing 2-unit workflow scope. I assign the supplied senior dispatcher to record the two rows during the clinic: reserve 30 minutes for the two worker sequences and up to 20 additional minutes for completing and checking those records within the existing two-hour clinic. Recording adds no worker time beyond their 15 minutes; unavailable fields stay explicitly unavailable. This is a scoped assignment, not evidence that attendance or handoff acknowledgement has occurred. I authorize no new across-shift collection staffing.

I cannot confirm that two attendees, an acknowledging overnight supervisor or the assessor's two reviews have actually been arranged. The scientist disclosed review capacity, not a completed booking. I therefore choose no release on the current evidence. The draft retains the 9-unit package and records the clinic design and its prerequisites, but does not authorize the clinic exercises or operational rollout. Audit and preparation can proceed; improved exception handling this week remains unobserved.

The draft separates our proposed operational checklist from the scientist's assessment advice. It preserves the changed-denominator and missing-annotation limitations, restricts assessor review to two attempts, and makes no certification, retention or workforce-wide transfer claim. The remaining unit is unspent; the fallback drill is excluded. I endorse these exact draft bytes in my own operational capacity only. Your commitment to the audit is recorded as a source, not as endorsement of the draft. The unresolved questions remain attendee availability, supervisor acknowledgement and assessor scheduling; I have no supplied confirmation for them.

claims.claim: I accept the analyst's bounded 2-unit audit commitment and its stated comparison and collection limits.

I absorb the acknowledgement form and two record templates into the 2-unit workflow scope and assign the supplied senior dispatcher 30 minutes of worker sequences plus up to 20 minutes of record completion within the two-hour clinic; this assigns capacity rather than asserting attendance or demonstrated feasibility.
The supplied and delivered evidence does not confirm attendee availability, actual supervisor acknowledgement or scheduled assessor reviews; I choose no release, with audit and preparation only.
I adopt the scientist's limits for implementation: practice checkpoints and exactly two changed cases carry no independent-competence, retention or workforce-wide transfer claim.
The scoped package totals 9 units including the single consultation, leaves 1 unspent and excludes the additional 3-unit fallback drill.
I endorse this draft in my own operational authority only; the analyst's audit commitment does not constitute their exact-byte endorsement.
